## AI SDR Terms Worth Knowing Before You Compare

AI SDR is software that performs sales development work: researching accounts, sourcing contacts, and drafting or sending outreach.

Autonomous agent is an AI SDR that runs list-to-meeting without a person approving each message.

Copilot is an AI SDR that researches and drafts, then routes the message to a human before it sends.

results.title: Best Open Source AI Sales Agents
results.content:
Open agent software does not make the sales supply chain open. Contact records, enrichment, email validation, mailboxes, carrier services, model APIs, and consent data remain separately licensed, metered, and regulated.

## The AI-SDR reset: what the evidence supports

AI SDRs attracted large investments and ambitious replacement claims. 11x announced a $24 million Series A in September 2024, while TechCrunch reported from sources that its Series B was roughly $50 million at about a $350 million valuation (11x, TechCrunch). The Series B figures are reported estimates, not company-confirmed facts. [...] The useful comparison is not “Which bot replaces an SDR?” It is “Which sales infrastructure should we buy, and which workflow logic should we own?”

## What “open source AI sales agent” should mean

Use three tests:

1. Code: Is the functional product source available?
2. License: Can users run, modify, and redistribute it under a recognized open-source license?
3. Deployment: Can the buyer operate the relevant product without a vendor-only control plane?

Eigent's application repository is Apache-2.0 and supports a local/self-hosted path (Eigent repository, license). The five commercial vendors in this comparison do not publish an open-source license for their core products. [...] By 2025, public reporting showed the limits of a simple “replace the SDR team” story. TechCrunch reported allegations around 11x customer logos, early break-clause churn, product quality, and contracted-ARR accounting; 11x disputed material parts and said retention was then 79% (TechCrunch investigation). Artisan's CEO separately acknowledged that its first AI-SDR generation had low response, high churn, and severe launch-era hallucinations, while saying the product later improved (TechCrunch).

There is no audited category-wide 70–80% churn benchmark in the reviewed evidence. The responsible lesson is narrower: autonomous outbound needs a well-defined ICP, accurate data, approval gates, deliverability operations, and outcome measurement beyond messages sent.

results.title: AI SDR Agents Explained - Qualified
results.content:
You can think of an AI SDR agent as a virtual sales development representative (SDR) powered by artificial intelligence. They are also commonly referred to as AI SDRs and AI sales representatives.   
‍  
AI SDR agents are a marketing and sales automation tool that help go-to-market (GTM) leaders scale their pipeline generation efforts.   
  
They leverage the power of  AI to automate repetitive and tedious activities typically handled by human SDRs, especially for B2B sales and marketing teams.  
‍  
These AI SDR agents operate autonomously to automate prospecting, lead qualification, and engagement at scale without heavy lifting.
